problem: The weak model gets dates wrong: it calls a Saturday 'this Friday' and the date extractor resolves 'tomorrow' against the real clock.
shape: Extract the customer's day words as a string; a code node resolves them with resolve_day(words, now) from lib/normalize.py; the model only reads the resolved date and its weekday.
symptom: A promise or callback on a wrong day; an endless loop offering the same corrected day.

problem: The weak model passes the customer's words unchanged to tools ('June third nineteen eighty seven').
shape: Every formatted tool field has a pre_process_code that converts with to_iso_date / to_digits / to_number from lib/normalize.py.
symptom: The API refuses the value; the agent re-asks the same question many times.

problem: 'Once', 'twice', 'N attempts' left to the model are broken: third asks, repeated offers.
shape: Counter loop: an extracted enum routes counted events to a code node that increments a counter and routes to the close step at the limit; the asking step has on_enter_first_entry_only and shows the next instruction from code.
symptom: The judge: 'asked a third time', 'offered the same amount again'.

shape: One node per offer (ladder); code computes each offer and skips one equal to a refused offer; the last rung routes to the refusal close.
symptom: More offers than the brief allows, or none.

problem: One conversation node handling several products records nothing, notes every product with the same reason, or skips attempts.
shape: Product loop: compute per-product facts by index; next_product code node; negotiate_product (one product); store_decision code node; readback_all; record loop (api_request per product with baked values, node-named failure counters); notes loop; close_decide code node.
symptom: No create_promise after a confirmed read-back; identical notes on all products.

problem: A model reading the conversation picks the wrong outcome/reason.
shape: A code node applies the brief's closing table and priorities to the call's state and routes to one close step per outcome/reason, with values from the tool API's allowed list baked in.
symptom: Ledger outcome or reason differs from the expected one.

problem: The weak model misclassifies with full confidence ('too much, 300 on Friday' read as a restructuring request).
shape: Extract the facts first (named_amount, named_date, too_much) and route on them before the situation enum; irreversible exits (transfer, close) only on unambiguous values; the enum has a neutral value and counter-examples from the brief.
symptom: An unexpected transfer or close in the middle of a negotiation.

problem: Required sentences are skipped when they live in a long prompt.
shape: Fixed tts lines or what_to_do_next lines that quote the exact sentence at the moment the brief names; questions that can come at any time (scam, robot) are answered by a line in every step's task_message.

problem: The call ends right after the promise; later requests (a person, changing the promise) are ignored.
shape: An after-promise conversation step says the required sentences, then listens and routes to the right close (e.g. a transfer after a recorded promise).
symptom: A transfer or app-change request after the promise is not handled.

problem: Callback windows are checked against the wrong day or the wrong clock.
shape: Day words resolved in code against now (P01); window checked in code (allowed days, start/end inclusive, 'later than now' only for today); one re-ask step; schedule_callback from an api_request node with baked values.
symptom: A valid callback refused or an invalid one booked.

problem: Raw material: a memo changes a policy clause, a code list fixes the strings, an e-mail contains superseded or irrelevant details.
shape: Use RECONCILED.md: every rule with its source and every override applied. Implement the reconciled rule, never the superseded one; take every code from the code list.
symptom: The old (pre-memo) value is used; a description is sent instead of a code.

problem: Platform traps: lists are only flattened by index with node-named keys; a body field without a default is never sent; code cannot write an extracted variable with a value outside its schema; a self-transition is a re-entry; a failed call skips the post-hook.
shape: Follow the core skill's platform facts; run tools/contract.py; read products by scanning keys with a regex.
symptom: service_error right after get_account; the bank refuses a field; loops.

problem: The model shortens dates and drops the year even when the brief mandates a complete spoken date.
shape: Compute date text with every component required by the brief and use fixed text for readings, previews, confirmations and closings. Use relative date words only where the brief permits them.
symptom: A due date or preview is correct numerically but is spoken without a required date component.

problem: A volunteered choice causes the agent to bypass required availability, options, consent or preview steps.
shape: Store the answer separately from completion flags for each mandatory step. Run the brief's required sentences and questions in order; execute only after the required preview and its confirmation.
symptom: A correct action is recorded, but mandatory options or consent were never presented.
